title: Risk Landscape is 'Fairly Perilous' Says AXIS CEO Vince Tizzio
summary: Vince Tizzio, CEO of top global specialty insurer AXIS, said that his company sees the risk landscape as 'fairly perilous,' specifically in the marine landscape like the Strait of Hormuz or other areas exposed to conflict. Tizzio said that pricing for policies has increased 30% to 40% from the rates AXIS was charging a year ago as demand remains high and the company is willing to still take on risk.   (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump 'Came Off Looking Desperate' in UN Speech, Says Brett Bruen
summary: Brett Bruen, president of the Global Situation Room and former Obama administration official, said that Trump's speech at the UN General Assembly 'came off looking desperate' and was not indicative of a White House that is offering diplomacy from a position of strength.  Bruen said that Trump's comments in his speech about having 'the spoils' of Venezuela fly in the face of the why the United Nations was founded after the Second World War.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta’s Muse Drags Down Stocks That Depend on ‘Consumer Inertia’

title: SpaceXAI’s Grok Bot Gains Early Traction
summary: SpaceXAI’s Grok Bot has topped 400,000 weekly users roughly a month after its launch, offering an early look at demand for Elon Musk’s push into AI agents. The product, which is separate from the flagship Grok chatbot, is designed to operate more like an always-on employee as SpaceXAI competes with OpenAI and Anthropic in the growing market for AI agents. Bloomberg Tech's Ed Ludlow reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Addresses UN as Caution Grips Wall Street
summary: Get a jump-start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." President Trump takes center stage at the United Nations General Assembly as world leaders step up diplomatic efforts. Oil wavers as Saudi Arabia looks to resume flows through a key pipeline, while traders watch for signs of progress toward reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Plus, AI fears linger as chip competition heats up and data-center backlash grows. Principal Asset Management Chief Global Strategist Seema Shah and Goldman Sachs Chief US Equity Strategist Ben Snider weigh in as caution grips Wall Street following a rally that pushed stocks near all-time highs. (Source: Bloomberg)
